clue.text: Leaders of unions treat apprentices harshly in Western state

indicators.note: leaders are the ones at the front, so only the opening letter of each following word is kept

blocks.note: the initial letter of each of these four words

explanation.surface: Trade union bosses in a western American state are accused of bullying trainees.
explanation.definitionFit: Utah is a state in the western United States, home of Salt Lake City.

clue.text: Open University joined by new rugby forward

blocks.note: U is the standard abbreviation for university
N is the abbreviation for new
a lock is a second-row forward in a rugby scrum

explanation.surface: The Open University gains a new recruit who plays in the rugby pack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Open University' reads as one name, but the two words split: the first is the definition, the second the abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To unlock a door or box is to open it, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Raised money, as announced

indicators.note: something announced is spoken out, so the word is judged by its sound rather than its spelling

blocks.note: bread is slang for money; said out loud it matches a word spelt differently

explanation.surface: Someone raised funds and made a public announcement of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Children or animals that are bred have been raised or reared, so the past participles match.

clue.text: A fine and equitable business

blocks.note: taken as written
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
equitable means just or even-handed

explanation.surface: A company is described as fine and fair in its dealings.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter or concern, as in 'that's my business', a loose noun synonym.

clue.text: Classical quartet in sensual festive occasion

indicators.note: one item placed in another means it sits inside the other's letters

blocks.note: carnal means of the flesh, sensual
four written in classical Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A string quartet playing classical music at a rather sensual party.
explanation.definitionFit: A carnival is a public festival with processions and merrymaking, a festive occasion.

clue.text: Resorting to change around West Berlin, for example

indicators.note: the word is asked to change, so its letters are rearranged into another order
the reworked letters go around the next piece, enclosing it

blocks.note: these nine letters are rearranged
W is the abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: Talk of resorting to change in West Berlin, the Cold War city.
explanation.walkthrough: Berlin is not the German city but Irving Berlin, composer of 'White Christmas'.
explanation.definitionFit: Irving Berlin wrote hundreds of popular songs, so he is an example of a songwriter.

clue.text: First and foremost, partly represent

indicators.note: only part of the phrase is used, so the letters lie inside the words running across their breaks

blocks.note: the letters run through the end of the first word, all of the second and the start of the third

explanation.surface: Above all, a representative should speak for others, at least partly.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters that stand for something represent it, as initials do a name; the phrasal verb is a synonym.

clue.text: First gear

blocks.note: surface reading: the lowest setting in a car's gearbox
setter's reading: the very first clothing ever worn, by Adam and Eve in Genesis

explanation.walkthrough: Gear here is clothing, and the first garment in the Bible story was the covering Adam and Eve sewed from a tree's leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Adam and Eve covered themselves with this plant's leaves after the Fall, the earliest gear anyone wore.

clue.text: Continue drawing attention to wine bottle

blocks.note: to flag something is to draw attention to it
to go on is to continue

explanation.surface: Someone keeps pointing out a bottle of wine.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces sit in the grid in reverse clue order: flag on, as in 'carry on flagging'.
explanation.definitionFit: A flagon is a large vessel, often with a handle, used to hold wine or other drink.

clue.text: Many people in the wrong – we backed out

indicators.note: backed means going backwards, so the little word is read in the opposite direction
out means leaving, so those letters are taken away

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written, then turned round

explanation.surface: A crowd of people in the wrong, and we backed out of the dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: Take E and W, in that order, out of THE WRONG to leave THRONG.
explanation.definitionFit: A throng is a large, dense crowd, so it means many people gathered together.

clue.text: Way to remove water gardenia badly needed

indicators.note: something done badly is botched and jumbled, so the letters come out in a new order

blocks.note: the eight letters of this flower are rearranged

explanation.surface: A waterlogged gardenia urgently needs its soil drained.
explanation.definitionFit: Drainage is a system of pipes or channels that carries away surplus water.

clue.text: Support behind club, non-executive director?

blocks.note: to back someone is to support them
the seat is one's behind, the bottom
a driver is a golf club

explanation.surface: Backing for a club whose board has a non-executive director.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is playful: someone who directs the driving from the back without being in charge of the car.
explanation.definitionFit: A back-seat driver is a passenger who gives unwanted directions, a director with no executive power.

clue.text: Company taken in by cunning academic or member of clergy

indicators.note: taken in by means received within, so the first item sits inside the other

blocks.note: arch means slyly knowing or cunning
a dean is a senior university academic
CO is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A firm is fooled by a crafty don or a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: An archdeacon is a senior Anglican cleric ranking just below a bishop.

clue.text: Part of US having taxes evenly redistributed?

indicators.note: redistributed means shared out again in a new way, so the letters are put in a different order

blocks.note: these five letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A region of America where taxes are shared out fairly.
explanation.definitionFit: Texas is one of the fifty states, a constituent part of the United States.

clue.text: Pain recurring in stomach each evening

indicators.note: the word sits inside the following words and turns up there twice, which is why it is said to recur

blocks.note: the letters run across the first two words, and again across the last two

explanation.surface: A stomach pain that comes back every evening.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a dull, continuing pain, so the nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Aspect of fairness, English characteristic

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for English
a quality is a characteristic or attribute

explanation.surface: Fair play is held up as a typically English characteristic.
explanation.definitionFit: Equality, everyone treated the same, is one element of what we mean by justice or fairness.

clue.text: Sent message that gets fellow fired

blocks.note: F is the abbreviation for fellow
axed means sacked from a job

explanation.surface: A message is sent that gets a colleague sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: To fax is to send a document by facsimile transmission, so the past tense means sent a message.

clue.text: Mausoleum site shown in indistinct drawing

indicators.note: shown in means displayed within, so one piece goes inside another

blocks.note: dim means faint or indistinct
Agra in India is the site of the Taj Mahal, a mausoleum

explanation.surface: A blurry sketch shows where a great tomb stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagram is a simplified drawing showing how something is laid out or works.

clue.text: Instrument that's plucked or one that's blown, not loudly at first

indicators.note: not means without, so the music term that follows is removed
at first places the removed letter at the very start of the word

blocks.note: a flute is a wind instrument, played by blowing
f, for forte, is the musical marking for loudly

explanation.surface: Choosing between a plucked instrument and a wind instrument played softly at first.
explanation.definitionFit: A lute is a pear-shaped stringed instrument whose strings are plucked by the player's fingers.

clue.text: Inconsistently applied principle somehow adds to a blunder

indicators.note: somehow suggests an unspecified way of doing it, so the letters are rearranged in some fashion

blocks.note: these fourteen letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Applying a rule unevenly only makes a mistake worse.
explanation.definitionFit: A double standard is a rule applied differently to different people, an inconsistent principle.

clue.text: Became capable of a run in fast time

indicators.note: placed in means set inside, so the first items go within the other

blocks.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting before Easter
taken as written
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An athlete became able to run fast within a given time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fast' looks like speed, but it means going without food, and the fast time is Lent.
explanation.definitionFit: Having learnt a skill, you become capable of it; learnt is the British past tense of learn.

clue.text: Change route of flier on time

blocks.note: a diver is a bird, the loon, so a flier
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A pilot is redirected because of the timing.
explanation.definitionFit: To divert traffic or a flight is to send it by a different route.

clue.text: Hard book – after all, that's an indication of quality

indicators.note: after tells us the item before it is placed later, following the next item

blocks.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
taken as written
Mark is a book of the New Testament

explanation.surface: A hardback book is, after all, a sign of quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After all' reads as a set phrase, but 'after' places the book behind 'all'.
explanation.definitionFit: A hallmark is the stamp on gold or silver certifying its purity, hence any mark of quality.

clue.text: Family supported by daughter showing generosity

indicators.note: in a down entry, supported means held up from below, so the next piece goes underneath

blocks.note: kin are one's relatives
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A family whose daughter takes care of them shows great generosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind means considerate and generous to others, so it describes someone showing generosity.

clue.text: Disgust partner, returning gift finally

indicators.note: returning means coming back the way it went, so the word is read backwards
finally points to the end, so only the closing letter is kept

blocks.note: a lover is a romantic partner
the last letter of this word

explanation.surface: A partner sends back a present, which appals the giver.
explanation.definitionFit: To revolt is to repel or sicken someone, so it is a verb synonym of disgust.

clue.text: Want to take it easy when head's away

indicators.note: the head is the front, and its being away means the opening letter is dropped

blocks.note: to slack is to idle or take it easy

explanation.surface: Wishing to relax while the headteacher is out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Want' looks like a verb of wishing, but it is the noun meaning shortage.
explanation.definitionFit: Want in the sense of need or shortage, as in 'for want of', means lack.

clue.text: American city less British, in short? The reverse

indicators.note: the reverse means the opposite way round, so the letters built up are read backwards

blocks.note: not so is a way of saying less, as in 'not so big'
British shortened to its abbreviation

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about an American city being less British.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In short' asks for the abbreviation of British, not a summary.
explanation.definitionFit: Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, a major city on the US east coast.

clue.text: Ability to figure menu out, not lacking spice

indicators.note: out suggests something put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: these four letters are rearranged
racy means lively or spicy, with plenty of spice

explanation.surface: Working out the bill from a menu that is full of spicy dishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' looks like a shape, but here it means to calculate.
explanation.definitionFit: Numeracy is competence with numbers, the ability to do arithmetic or figure things out.
